theorems.name: Submission.besicovitch_ratio_cover_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (μ ν : Measure (Euclidean N)) (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (ρ₀ : ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ σ < ρ₀ ∧ μ (closedBall x σ) ≤ t * ν (closedBall x σ)) → μ A ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * t * ν (thickening ρ₀ A)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
